title: Build a Normalized Gaussian Blur Kernel

references.label: Original Luma AI MLE assessment report

prompt:
An image-processing pipeline needs a square Gaussian blur kernel. Implement `gaussian_kernel(k, sigma)` and return a `k × k` 2D list of floating weights sampled from an isotropic Gaussian at integer offsets around the center. A weight at offset `(row, col)` is proportional to `exp(-(row² + col²) / (2 × sigma²))`. Normalize the weights so the whole kernel sums to one.

`k` is a positive odd integer and `sigma` is a positive finite number. Construct the kernel only; no image convolution is requested.

example.reasoning: A one-cell kernel has all the weight.
